testCases.name: Publisher presents one customer task with the owner facts behind technical details

testEnvironment.description: Self-contained E2E test with mocked catalog endpoints and in-memory fixtures

scenarioDescription.userStory: User views available runtime versions in the Publisher page
scenarioDescription.coverage: Console UI fetches runtime catalog from BFF, which queries Runtime Control's catalog projection. The test verifies that the page correctly displays the policy-selected default runtime (second catalog row, not first), hides it behind a technical details disclosure for customer simplicity, and blocks build submission when the policy is unavailable.
keyValidations: Runtime catalog endpoint returns multiple versions with approval status
Page selects the runtime marked defaultForNewBuilds=true (OPL App Runtime default)
Page does NOT auto-select the first catalog row
Technical details are hidden in collapsed disclosure by default
Customer sees simplified single-task experience without development jargon
Build submission is blocked when policy default is unavailable
Mobile navigation renders on single row without obscuring primary actions
Primary action button remains accessible above mobile navigation (44px+ touch target)

notClaimed: Real S6 Runtime Control deployment connectivity
Production database with actual catalog data
Real policy enforcement from Runtime Control service
